# velum

> chat with the best ai models without giving up your identity. no email,
> password, or username - signing up generates a random 16-digit account
> number, which is both the only identity and the only way back in. credit
> is bought up front (100 credits = $1.00) and billed per token actually
> used, no subscription. the codebase is open source (AGPL-3.0) and
> self-hostable.

## Product

- [Home](https://velum.run/): what velum is and how it works, start to
  finish.
- [Pricing](https://velum.run/pricing): per-model token rates and how
  credits are billed.
- [FAQ](https://velum.run/faq): billing, payment methods, model selection,
  tool use (web search, code execution, image generation), data controls.

## Capabilities

- Chat with a curated set of models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and
  others) through OpenRouter, grouped by use case: efficient, flagship,
  coding, vision, long context, and uncensored.
- Models can automatically use tools mid-conversation: web search, fetching
  a specific page, running Python in an isolated sandbox, and generating
  images.
- Chat content, titles, and custom instructions are encrypted at rest with
  a separate key per account.
- Payment via card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank transfer (no processor
  sees chat content); Monero support is planned.
